description: A script for compiling IDL files into Blink V8 bindings, including code generation and command-line parsing.

classes.name: IdlCompiler
classes.description: An abstract class for compiling IDL files into code, supporting different code generators and configurations.

methods.name: parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options and returns options and input filename.

methods.name: compile_and_write
methods.description: Reads IDL definitions and generates code files based on the target component.

methods.name: compile_file
methods.description: Compiles a single IDL file by invoking compile_and_write.
